summary.scope: All authored dialogue/choice branches, inspectable fallbacks, pending and terminal epilogues. Includes conservative default prompts even when a prior branch necessarily selects a variant.
summary.estimateNote: Unique corpus, not one playthrough. USD is an illustrative standard-neural rate, not an Azure quote; excludes SSML billing overhead, probes and assessment.

master_format: 24kHz 16-bit mono raw PCM; retained outside repository

cast_approval.human_approval_reference: Parent Game soundtrack relayed the user's exact response 'Cool! Approved!' after reviewing the restored audio studio at http://127.0.0.1:4193 in response to cast/pronunciation approval.
cast_approval.scope: Full 698-block / 2265-segment RU/EN cast and pronunciations, including the identified audition listening flags. Human approval is not automated PASS and does not lower thresholds or pre-approve unheard new defects.

recording_release_approval.human_response: Approve the final recording with the documented flags; integrate it
recording_release_approval.human_question: After reviewing the final samples, should I integrate the complete recording with these documented speech-review caveats, or revise specific lines first? This decision covers the final recording, not just the earlier cast auditions.
recording_release_approval.timestamp_meaning: Local machine clock captured when recording the parent-relayed approval receipt; not the unavailable exact user-message timestamp.
recording_release_approval.human_review_reference: Parent Game soundtrack relayed the user's explicit final-recording release selection on 2026-09-16 after the frozen version 1 review prompt and documented caveats.
recording_release_approval.disclosure: The user was told about 15 priority listening examples, ambiguous short Russian words/names, spoken chapter numbers, Ivet naturalness, and 219 new automated flags retained as flags rather than PASS. The decision accepts the complete unchanged recording with these limitations; it does not claim that every flagged line was individually heard.
recording_release_approval.recording_scope: All 2265 unchanged final masters in release-review-v1/master-hashes.json; 698 exact bilingual runtime blocks.
caveats: All2265 source segments exist; no clipping, empty audio, hash mismatch or timing compression.
Raw scores are not all PASS.32 exact possessive-token bookkeeping corrections retain original evidence.
Some Russian function words merge naturally in speech; ASR alone cannot prove they were omitted.

Roman chapter labels are deliberately spoken as numbers. Whole-file ASR recovers several title continuations missed by single-utterance recognition, but short/name phrases remain weak recognition cases.
Review the short Russian Хорошо and Раут мёртв clips explicitly; one returns no independent transcript while pronunciation assessment scores it100.
One Russian Ivet whole-block sample has NISQA MOS3.90; the other43 representative samples are above4.7. Scores do not certify pronunciation or acting.
No new generation or blanket automated score override was performed. Final release remains a separate human decision.
recording_release_approval.scope: Informed release acceptance of unchanged recordings with disclosed metrics; not a claim that every flagged line was listened to individually.
